description: This file contains the 'AutoFilter' class responsible for writing AutoFilter XML elements in an XLSX file, including filtering rules and filter columns. It interacts with worksheet objects, AutoFilter columns, and rules to generate the appropriate XML structure for Excel AutoFilter features.

classes.name: AutoFilter
classes.description: A class for writing the AutoFilter XML in XLSX files, including filter criteria and selected ranges.

methods.name: writeAutoFilter
methods.description: Generates the XML for the AutoFilter element based on worksheet auto filter settings.

methods.name: writeAutoFilterColumn
methods.description: Writes XML for a specific filter column, including its filtering rules.

methods.name: writeAutoFilterColumnRule
methods.description: Writes the filter rule details (e.g., operator, value, type) into the XML.
